correctness.rationale: PASS — A length-2k antisquare contains k ones. The valuation-parity word has ones only at i≡b−1 mod b, so separation immediately excludes k≥2 at b≥4 and k≥3 at b=3. At b=3,k=2, the only candidate is 1001 at i=3q+2, with even ν_3(q+1),ν_3(q+2). At b=2 every even-index symbol is 0; k ones force alternating words and parity of complementary halves requires odd k, while four consecutive odd positions contain one forced 0, leaving k=1 or3. The exceptional length-six factors occur exactly when ν_2(q+2) is positive even. Transition 10/01 positions are odd-valuation tests ν_b(i+1),ν_b(i+2); floor-series H_b and E count all starts at each finite N and geometric sums give densities 1/(b+1),1/6,1/12, with logarithmic floor errors. Independent direct enumeration for bases 2,3,4,5,7 over starts i<400 and orders k≤23 exactly matched all factor supports and prefix counts, including base2 133+133 transitions and 33+33 length-six starts, base3 100+100 transitions and 67 occurrences of 1001. Proof, not test horizon, establishes infinite completeness.
